notes: Fixes the freeze. Boost assist was writing AssemblyLinearVelocity every frame to a car the server simulates - a replication round trip per frame, which stalls the game. It is now off by default, can never be restored to on by an old config, runs at 15 Hz for the local driver only, and switches itself off within 3s if the speed does not actually rise. The gas poller also dropped to 2 Hz and a scan that finds nothing can no longer repeat more than once every 2.5s.
